newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Brahma still a sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Brahma still a sell.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said in a report it was maintaining its sell rating for Brazilian brewery Brahma.
-- Analyst Juliana Chu raised 1997 EBITDA estimate to 721 million reais from 657 million reais and 1997 net income forecast to 286 million reais from 275 million reais.
-- "We are maintaining our sell recommendation as the company's financial indicators remain high and the stock is trading at a premium of 30 percent," she said.
-- Due to increased foreign investor interest on the stock, Brahma shares could perform in line with the IBOVESPA.
